errors.what: Initial Write to findings.json blocked because hop 1's findings.json still existed in the shared work dir
errors.error_message: File has not been read yet. Read it first before writing to it.
errors.recovered_by: Read the leftover hop-1 file first, confirmed its data was already merged into doc.clan, then overwrote it with my risk findings. Same pattern recurred for handoff.md; handled identically (overwrote with only my note since patch-context --append takes the file content as the new appended block).

problems_and_friction: The shared work directory still contained hop 1's findings.json and handoff.md, forcing read-before-overwrite and creating ambiguity about whether handoff.md should accumulate notes or hold only the current hop's note (I chose current-hop-only since --append patches it into the doc). Otherwise the clan CLI protocol was smooth: all four clan commands succeeded first try, and the agent-read output gave complete prior-hop context including exact pricing figures.
context_understood: I was hop 2 (risk-analyst) of a 3-agent serial CRM-evaluation pipeline for Brightline (40-person Dublin ad agency), tasked with producing a GDPR/lock-in/migration/hidden-cost/support risk analysis plus a severity-scored risk register on top of hop 1's pricing research, patched into doc.clan for the final recommendation agent.
